list_domains.title: List CDN domains
list_domains.description: List the account's accelerated domains with their CNAME, business type, status and SSL state. Start here.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The domains and the total count.

get_domain.title: Get a CDN domain
get_domain.description: Read one domain's CNAME, origins, business type, acceleration region and status.

add_domain.title: Add a CDN domain
add_domain.description: Add a domain to CDN with its origins. Then point the domain's CNAME at the returned CNAME to start acceleration. Ownership verification may be required first (see get_verify_content).

sources.description: JSON array string of origins, e.g. [{"content":"1.1.1.1","type":"ipaddr","priority":"20","port":80,"weight":"10"}]. type is ipaddr, domain, oss or fc_domain.

update_domain.title: Change origins
update_domain.description: Replace a domain's origin servers or move it to a different resource group.

sources.description: JSON array string of origins, as for add_domain.

start_domain.title: Enable a CDN domain
start_domain.description: Enable a stopped domain so CDN serves it again.

stop_domain.title: Disable a CDN domain
stop_domain.description: Stop accelerating a domain. Its CNAME stops answering requests, so switch DNS back to the origin first.

delete_domain.title: Remove a CDN domain
delete_domain.description: Remove a domain from CDN with its configuration. Point DNS back to the origin first, or the site goes offline.

get_verify_content.title: Get the ownership token
get_verify_content.description: Get the TXT record value (or file content) needed to prove ownership of a domain before adding it.

verify_domain_owner.title: Verify domain ownership
verify_domain_owner.description: Check the DNS TXT record or uploaded file that proves ownership of a domain.

get_domain_configs.title: Get domain features
get_domain_configs.description: Read a domain's feature configuration (cache rules, HTTPS redirect, referer and IP lists, headers, compression and more).

function_names.description: Comma-separated feature names, e.g. filetype_based_ttl_set,https_force; omit for all.

set_domain_configs.title: Set domain features
set_domain_configs.description: Set features on one or more domains. functions is a JSON array string of {functionName, functionArgs:[{argName, argValue}]} entries from the CDN feature reference.

delete_domain_config.title: Delete a domain feature
delete_domain_config.description: Remove one feature configuration from a domain by its config ID.

set_https_certificate.title: Set a domain's HTTPS certificate
set_https_certificate.description: Turn HTTPS on or off for a domain, using an uploaded certificate, a certificate from Certificate Management Service, or a free one.

cert_id.description: The certificate ID in Certificate Management Service.

ssl_pri.description: The PEM private key, for upload.

get_certificate_info.title: Get a domain's certificate
get_certificate_info.description: Read the HTTPS certificate on a domain: issuer, subject, validity and status.

refresh_cache.title: Purge cached content
refresh_cache.description: Purge files, directories or regex matches from the CDN cache so the next request goes to the origin. Counts against the daily refresh quota.

object_path.description: URLs to purge, newline-separated (up to 1000), e.g. https://cdn.example.com/app.js.

force.description: Purge even if the origin's resource is unchanged.

prefetch_cache.title: Prefetch content
prefetch_cache.description: Warm the CDN cache by fetching files from the origin before users ask for them. Counts against the daily prefetch quota.

list_refresh_tasks.title: List purge and prefetch tasks
list_refresh_tasks.description: List purge and prefetch tasks with their status and progress.

end_time.description: End, UTC ISO 8601; the window may not exceed 31 days.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

get_refresh_quota.title: Get purge and prefetch quotas
get_refresh_quota.description: Read today's purge and prefetch quotas and how much of each remains.

get_bandwidth.title: Get bandwidth
get_bandwidth.description: Read bandwidth (bps) for one or more domains over a time window, at 5-minute, hourly or daily granularity.

domain_name.description: One domain, or up to 500 comma-separated; omit for all.

end_time.description: End, UTC ISO 8601; the window may not exceed 31 days.

location_name_en.description: Filter by region name, e.g. beijing.

get_qps.title: Get request rate
get_qps.description: Read requests per second for one or more domains over a time window, at 5-minute, hourly or daily granularity.

domain_name.description: One domain, or up to 500 comma-separated; omit for all.

end_time.description: End, UTC ISO 8601; the window may not exceed 31 days.

location_name_en.description: Filter by region name, e.g. beijing.

get_traffic.title: Get traffic
get_traffic.description: Read network traffic (bytes) for one or more domains over a time window, at 5-minute, hourly or daily granularity.

domain_name.description: One domain, or up to 500 comma-separated; omit for all.

end_time.description: End, UTC ISO 8601; the window may not exceed 31 days.

location_name_en.description: Filter by region name, e.g. beijing.

get_hit_rate.title: Get cache hit rate
get_hit_rate.description: Read the byte cache hit ratio for one or more domains over a time window, at 5-minute, hourly or daily granularity.

domain_name.description: One domain, or up to 500 comma-separated; omit for all.

end_time.description: End, UTC ISO 8601; the window may not exceed 31 days.

location_name_en.description: Filter by region name, e.g. beijing.

output.description: The byte cache hit ratio data points.

get_status_codes.title: Get HTTP status codes
get_status_codes.description: Read the distribution of HTTP status codes for one or more domains over a time window, at 5-minute, hourly or daily granularity.

domain_name.description: One domain, or up to 500 comma-separated; omit for all.

end_time.description: End, UTC ISO 8601; the window may not exceed 31 days.

location_name_en.description: Filter by region name, e.g. beijing.

output.description: The distribution of http status codes data points.

get_origin_bandwidth.title: Get origin bandwidth
get_origin_bandwidth.description: Read back-to-origin bandwidth for one or more domains over a time window, at 5-minute, hourly or daily granularity.

domain_name.description: One domain, or up to 500 comma-separated; omit for all.

end_time.description: End, UTC ISO 8601; the window may not exceed 31 days.

location_name_en.description: Filter by region name, e.g. beijing.

get_top_urls.title: Get top URLs
get_top_urls.description: List the most requested URLs for a domain on a given day, by traffic or by visit count.

sort_by.description: Rank by traffic or by visits.

get_top_referers.title: Get top referers
get_top_referers.description: List the referring pages that send the most traffic to a domain on a given day.

sort_by.description: Rank by traffic or by visits.

list_domain_logs.title: List access log files
list_domain_logs.description: List downloadable access log files for a domain, with their URLs and sizes.

end_time.description: End, UTC ISO 8601; the window may not exceed 31 days.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The log files and download links.

lookup_ip.title: Check whether an IP is a CDN node
lookup_ip.description: Check whether an IP address belongs to an Alibaba Cloud CDN node, and its region and carrier.

output.description: CdnIp (True or False), ISP and region.

get_service.title: Get the CDN service status
get_service.description: Read the CDN service's billing method, status and any pending billing change.

get_user_quota.title: Get account quotas
get_user_quota.description: Read the account's CDN quotas: domains, purges and prefetches, and how many are used.
